name: Seed-Warming Censer (Ôn Chủng Lô)
lore: A squat red-clay censer that Ninh Trúc Thực carries into the grove every spring and sets burning at the foot of the oldest clump. He feeds it with his own Fire and walks the rows for nine nights until the culms flower. It is how the garden has had a seed every year since 1050 (A246), and no one else in the garden has the Fire to light it.
build_use: The farmer's sustain piece: longer Wood buffs and a warm Fire stack with regeneration whenever he tends his Wood buffs.
made_by: ninh_truc_thuc, with clay from Thủy Điền Thôn

name: Rain-Measure Gourd (Lượng Vũ Hồ Lô)
lore: A bottle gourd marked inside with nine rings, which Úy Thương Điền fills from the sky each wet season to know how much water the terraces may take. She has kept a record of the rains since 1108 and knows the land is drying in the years the grove is forced to seed.
build_use: The water elder's flood: longer floods and longer Water stacks.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Bell of the Flowering (Khai Hoa Chung)
lore: A bamboo-tube bell that rang by itself in 990 and again in 1050, the two years the grove flowered. It has been silent since he began forcing the seed.
build_use: His side outlasts: regeneration and a guard.

name: Seed-Picker's Ring (Thái Chủng Nhẫn)
lore: The plaited bamboo-root ring of the seed-picker who bore him, worn smooth by sixty years of picking seed.
build_use: Growth and mending: Wood buff stacks and healing.
made_by: a seed-picker of the garden, his parent

name: Fan of the Flood Terraces (Thủy Điền Phiến)
lore: A palm-leaf fan of the kind the terrace workers use to drive water down the channels. She cut the first terraces with it in 1108.
build_use: Drowns the ground and feeds the Wood.

name: Fisher's Oilskin (Ngư Du Bào)
lore: Her father's oilskin from Bích Lãng Thôn, the one coat on the hill that keeps the flood out.
build_use: A body that stands in its own flood.
